arxiv-2003-09978.title: Thermo-Optic Multi-Stability and Relaxation in Silicon Microring Resonators with Lateral Diodes
arxiv-2003-09978.creator: Dodd Gray, Ryan Hamerly, Meysam Namdari, Mircea-Traian Cătuneanu, Nate Bogdanowicz, Hideo Mabuchi, Kambiz Jamshidi
arxiv-2003-09978.description: Abstract We demonstrate voltage-tunable thermo-optic bi- and tri-stability in silicon photonic microring resonators with lateral p-i-n junctions and present a technique for characterizing the thermo-optic transient response of integrated optical resonators. Our method for thermo-optic transient response measurement is applicable to any integrated photonics platform and uses standard equipment.

arxiv-2109-06059.title: Quantum Criticality of Anti-ferromagnetism and Superconductivity with Relativity
arxiv-2109-06059.creator: Hanqing Liu, Emilie Huffman, Shailesh Chandrasekharan, Ribhu K. Kaul
arxiv-2109-06059.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Hanqing Liu, Emilie Huffman, Shailesh Chandrasekharan, Ribhu K. Kaul. We study a quantum phase transition from a massless to massive Dirac fermion phase in a new two-dimensional bipartite lattice model of electrons that is amenable to sign-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations. Importantly, interactions in our model are not only invariant under SU ⁡ ( 2 ) \operatorname{SU}(2) symmetries of spin and charge like the Hubbard model, but they also preserve an Ising like electron spin-charge flip symmetry.

arxiv-2111-08652.title: Covariant 3+1 correspondence of the spatially covariant gravity and the degeneracy conditions
arxiv-2111-08652.creator: Yu-Min Hu, Xian Gao
arxiv-2111-08652.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Yu-Min Hu, Xian Gao. A necessary condition for a generally covariant scalar-tensor theory to be ghostfree is that it contains no extra degrees of freedom in the unitary gauge, in which the Lagrangian corresponds to the spatially covariant gravity. Comparing with analysing the scalar-tensor theory directly, it is simpler to map the spatially covariant gravity to the generally covariant scalar-tensor theory using the gauge recovering procedures.

arxiv-2206-05663.title: Synchronization based model for turbulent thermoacoustic systems
arxiv-2206-05663.creator: Yue Weng, Vishnu R. Unni, R. I. Sujith, Abhishek Saha, emails: vishnu.runni@mae.iith.ac.in & \& asaha@eng.ucsd.edu
arxiv-2206-05663.description: Abstract We present a phenomenological reduced-order model to capture the transition to thermoacoustic instability in turbulent combustors. The model is based on the framework of synchronization and considers the acoustic field and the unsteady heat release rate from turbulent reactive flow as two nonlinearly coupled sub-systems. arxiv-2307-12199.title: Leveraging Historical Medical Records as a Proxy via Multimodal Modeling and Visualization to Enrich Medical Diagnostic Learning
arxiv-2307-12199.creator: \authororcid Yang Ouyang0009-0000-5841-7659, \authororcid Yuchen Wu0009-0005-8333-4405, \authororcid He Wang0009-0003-2550-6139, \authororcid Chenyang Zhang0009-0003-1116-4895, \authororcid Furui Cheng0000-0003-2329-6126, Chang Jiang, Lixia Jin, Yuanwu Cao, and \authororcid Quan Li0000-0003-2249-072
arxiv-2307-12199.description: Abstract Simulation-based Medical Education (SBME) has been developed as a cost-effective means of enhancing the diagnostic skills of novice physicians and interns, thereby mitigating the need for resource-intensive mentor-apprentice training. However, feedback provided in most SBME is often directed towards improving the operational proficiency of learners, rather than providing summative medical diagnoses that result from experience and time.

arxiv-2409-00751.title: Self-Supervised Vision Transformers for Writer Retrieval
arxiv-2409-00751.creator: Tim Raven ✉, Arthur Matei, Gernot A. Fink
arxiv-2409-00751.description: Abstract While methods based on Vision Transformers (ViT) have achieved state-of-the-art performance in many domains, they have not yet been applied successfully in the domain of writer retrieval. The field is dominated by methods using handcrafted features or features extracted from Convolutional Neural Networks.

arxiv-2503-13789.title: Carbonic anhydrase II simulated with a universal neural network potential.
arxiv-2503-13789.creator: Tim Duignan
arxiv-2503-13789.description: Abstract The carbonic anhydrase II enzyme (CA II) is one of the most significant enzymes in nature, reversibly converting CO 2 to bicarbonate at a remarkable rate. The precise mechanism it uses to achieve this rapid turnover remains unclear due to our inability to directly observe or simulate the full process dynamically.

arxiv-2504-11388.title: Local solubility in generalised Châtelet varieties
arxiv-2504-11388.creator: Kevin Destagnol, Julian Lyczak, Efthymios Sofos
arxiv-2504-11388.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kevin Destagnol, Julian Lyczak, Efthymios Sofos. We obtain asymptotic formulas for averages of general multivariate arithmetic functions evaluated at polynomial arguments using recent work of Rydin Myerson and Rome–Yamagishi. We give several applications of our results in analytic number theory and arithmetic geometry.

arxiv-2505-08927.title: Predictive Digital Twins with Quantified Uncertainty for Patient-Specific Decision Making in Oncology
arxiv-2505-08927.creator: Graham Pash, Umberto Villa, David A. Hormuth II, Thomas E. Yankeelov, Karen Willcox
arxiv-2505-08927.description: Abstract Quantifying the uncertainty in predictive models is critical for establishing trust and enabling risk-informed decision making for personalized medicine. In contrast to one-size-fits-all approaches that seek to mitigate risk at the population level, digital twins enable personalized modeling thereby potentially improving individual patient outcomes.

arxiv-2505-21643.title: First IFU observations of two GRB host galaxies at cosmic noon with JWST/NIRSpec
arxiv-2505-21643.creator: B. Topçu, P. Schady, S. Wuyts, A. Inkenhaag, M. Arabsalmani, H.-W. Chen, L. Christensen, V. D’Elia, J. P. U. Fynbo, K. E. Heintz, P. Jakobsson, T. Laskar, A. Levan, G. Pugliese, A. Rossi, R. L. C. Starling, N. R. Tanvir, P. Wiseman, R.M. Yates
arxiv-2505-21643.description: Abstract Long gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) serve as powerful probes of distant galaxies. Their luminous afterglow pinpoints galaxies independent of luminosity, in contrast to most flux-limited surveys. Nevertheless, GRB-selected galaxy samples are not free from bias, instead tracing the conditions favoured by the progenitor stars.

arxiv-2507-11479.title: Perspective-Aware AI in Extended Reality
arxiv-2507-11479.creator: Daniel Platnick, Matti Gruener, Marjan Alirezaie, Kent Larson, Dava J. Newman, Hossein Rahnama
arxiv-2507-11479.description: Abstract AI-enhanced Extended Reality (XR) aims to deliver adaptive, immersive experiences—yet current systems fall short due to shallow user modeling and limited cognitive context. We introduce Perspective-Aware AI in Extended Reality (PAiR), a foundational framework for integrating Perspective-Aware AI (PAi) with XR to enable interpretable, context-aware experiences grounded in user identity.

europmc-pmc3460232.title: Flavonoids: biosynthesis, biological functions, and biotechnological applications.
europmc-pmc3460232.creator: Falcone Ferreyra ML, Rius SP, Casati P.
europmc-pmc3460232.description: Flavonoids are widely distributed secondary metabolites with different metabolic functions in plants. pmc-10672605.title: Fellow-Eye Comparison between Phaco-Tanito Microhook Trabeculotomy and Phaco-iStent Inject W
pmc-10672605.creator: Akiko Harano, Ayaka Shimada, Sho Ichioka, Kazunobu Sugihara, Masaki Tanito
pmc-10672605.description: This study aims to compare the surgical efficacy and safety of the Tanito microhook trabeculotomy (TMH-CE) and iStent inject W (Inject-CE) when performed in combination with cataract surgery on the eyes of glaucoma patients. A total of 78 glaucomatous eyes from 39 participants were retrospectively analyzed.

pmc-10695534.title: Ovarian cancer disease burden decreased in the United States from 1975 to 2018: A joinpoint and age-period-cohort analysis
pmc-10695534.creator: Jiahui He, Qinyong Hu
pmc-10695534.description: Ovarian cancer (OC) is the leading cause of gynecological cancer-related deaths in the United States. The purpose of this study was to evaluate long-term trends in OC incidence and incidence-based mortality rates (IBM) in the U.S. from 1975 to 2018 and to assess the effects of age, period, and cohort factors on OC incidence and mortality using an age-period-cohort model.

pmc-11323847.title: Aggressive giant dumbell-shaped thoracic vertebral hemangioma: illustrative case
pmc-11323847.creator: Matteo Gionso, Ali Baram, Mario De Robertis, Massimo Tomei, Daniele Ajello, Umberto Cariboni, Federico Pessina, Maurizio Fornari, Gabriele Capo
pmc-11323847.description: BACKGROUNDVertebral hemangioma is the most common benign tumor of the spine, diagnosed incidentally in most cases. In 0.4% of patients, the lesion is considered aggressive, causing neurological deficits. This subtype of hemangioma is characterized by strong postcontrast enhancement, cortical lysis, and epidural extension causing myelopathy and/or radiculopathy.

pmc-11634181.title: Extensive intraoperative peritoneal lavage with surgery, compared to surgery alone, for patients diagnosed with gastric cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-11634181.creator: Mariam Adil, Dua Ghori, Eman Anwar, Maryam Shaukat, Muhammad T.H. Malik, Dua A. Murtaza, Khadija A. Sumra, Rabia Essani, Urooj Nizami, Bakhtawer N. Khan, Hunaina Abid, Malik Olatunde Oduoye
pmc-11634181.description: Background:Gastric cancer ranks as the fifth most frequently diagnosed cancer and the seventh most prevalent overall. The lifetime risk of developing gastric cancer is 1.87% for males and 0.79% for females worldwide.Aim:This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to determine whether extensive intraoperative peritoneal lavage (EIPL) provides short-term benefits or improved survival outcomes for patients undergoing gastrectomy.

pmc-12358701.title: A database study of the safety and effectiveness of daily growth hormone in treating more than 80,000 children with growth disorders worldwide: a plain language summary of publication
pmc-12358701.creator: Mohamad Maghnie, Michael B Ranke, Mitchell E Geffner, Elpis Vlachopapadopoulou, Lourdes Ibáñez, Martin Carlsson, Wayne Cutfield, Raoul Rooman, Roy Gomez, Michael P Wajnrajch, Agnès Linglart, Renata Stawerska, Peter E Clayton, Feyza Darendeliler, Anita C S Hokken-Koelega, Reiko Horikawa, Toshiaki Tan
pmc-12358701.description: SummaryResearchers looked at data from the largest and longest-running database of children with growth disorders who were treated with daily injections of a brand of growth hormone called Genotropin. The researchers used these data to better understand the safety and effectiveness of daily growth hormone treatment.

pmc-12821946.title: Delineation and monitoring of the T cell repertoire of adoptive cell transfer product during the treatment of advanced melanoma
pmc-12821946.creator: Cameron Kerr, Shirin Soleimani, David T. Mulder, Arash Nabbi, Diana Gray, Stephanie Pedersen, Valentin Sotov, Sumedha Sudhaman, Linh Nguyen, Naoto Hirano, Pamela S. Ohashi, Marcus O. Butler, Trevor J. Pugh
pmc-12821946.description: BackgroundAdoptive cell transfer (ACT) of tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes (TIL) is an investigational treatment for solid tumours, with preliminary results showing objective clinical responses in some metastatic melanoma patients. The ability to sequence and track the T cell repertoire throughout ACT of TILs provides a method to identify T cell repertoire features associated with patients’ benefit from ACT.

pmc-12931669.title: Early evidence of the effects of xylazine-adulterated fentanyl in Ohio
pmc-12931669.creator: Daniel Rosenblum, George Karandinos, Jay Unick, Dennis Cauchon, Daniel Ciccarone
pmc-12931669.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background:Xylazine is becoming a prevalent fentanyl adulterant in the US. It has been associated with severe wounds and withdrawal symptoms. However, its impact on fatal overdose rates is poorly understood.Methods:Poisson and ordinary least squares regression analyses are used to estimate the relationship between xylazine prevalence and unintentional overdose death and death rates at the county-month level in Ohio from April through December 2023.

pmc-13236376.title: Endovascular management of a ruptured pancreaticoduodenal artery pseudoaneurysm using a stent-graft: a case report and literature review
pmc-13236376.creator: Anas A. Abukhalaf, Alaa R Al-Ihribat, Walid K.M Sabarna, Baraa M. AbuMandil, Rajai ALhusseini
pmc-13236376.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Pancreaticoduodenal artery (PDA) pseudoaneurysms are rare vascular complications, accounting for approximately 2% of all visceral artery aneurysms. They are often associated with chronic pancreatitis and have a high risk of rupture, which can be life-threatening.Case presentation:A 45-year-old male with a history of chronic alcoholic pancreatitis presented with recurrent epigastric pain radiating to the back, associated with anorexia and significant weight loss. He had undergone multiple prior endoscopies and biopsies without a definitive diagnosis.

pmc-13341359.title: Supporting Weight Management for Kidney Transplant Candidates in People With Obesity on Haemodialysis: The First National Survey of UK Kidney Healthcare Providers
pmc-13341359.creator: Adrian Brown, Helen L. MacLaughlin, Kieran McCafferty, Sebastian Potthoff, Sharlene Greenwood, Victoria Vickerstaff, Rachel L. Batterham, Rachel Thomas, Claudia Hobbs, Reza Motallebzadeh
